name: round-table-connector
description: Round Table connector API tools for a primary Grok Bot. Seats are public API products (Grok (API), Codex, Claude, Gemini, Muse, DeepSeek) using caller-provided keys — not fleet bots or BotBot.

auth.note: Connector session only — not fleet identity.

tools.name: rt_health
tools.description: Check Round Table connector API health. Returns service status and an honesty note that API seats are not fleet bots.

tools.name: rt_roster
tools.description: List Round Table seats: ids, public product display names (Grok (API), Codex, Claude, Gemini, Muse, DeepSeek), roles, and providerIds. No secrets.

tools.name: rt_set_secrets
tools.description: Store provider API keys for this connector session (encrypted at rest). Keys must be supplied via secure/hidden input — never echo key values in chat, logs, or tool results. Accepted providerIds: arbiter (xAI / Grok (API)), openai (Codex), anthropic (Claude), google (Gemini), meta (Muse), deepseek. Storing keys does not grant fleet identity.

keys.description: Map of providerId → API key string. Use secure input; values are never returned.

tools.name: rt_start_quest
tools.description: Create a Round Table quest from a goal. Runs a local preview arbiter split, or calls xAI via proxy when an arbiter key is stored. Returns quest id, status, proposal, and messages.

goal.description: The quest goal / prompt for the council.

enabledSeatIds.description: Optional knight seat ids to include (e.g. codex, claude). Defaults to all knights.

tools.name: rt_quest_status
tools.description: Fetch quest status, proposal, and messages so far by quest id.
